title: Crispy Moroccan Chickpea Tagine
description: A flavorful and spicy tagine dish made with crispy chickpeas, perfect for a satisfying dinner. This recipe is inspired by traditional Moroccan cuisine.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the moroccan spice blend and stir for 1 minute.
Add the chickpeas and stir to coat with the spice blend.
Add the split peas, water, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, heat some oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the crispy onions and stir to coat.
After 20 minutes, add the crispy onions to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Serve hot and garnish with additional crispy onions if desired.
